title: Lake Cote aerial survey photo

tellings.quote: And and and in Costa Rica, they were doing aerial mapping around this this uh uh arenal um area, Lake Coat.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a 1971 government mapping flight over the Arenal area of Costa Rica, near a lake called Lake Cote, where photos were being taken from the air. He brings it up along with the names of Sergio Loaiza and two UFO researchers, Jacques Vallee and Richard Haines, as a case where the survey camera is said to have caught something unexplained. If true, it would be a sighting recorded by an ordinary camera doing an ordinary job.
